title: Automated Architectural Compliance Review
business: Large-scale urban planning firms managing complex zoning regulations.
problem: Manual verification of architectural blueprints against thousands of pages of municipal zoning codes is error-prone and causes significant project delays.
solution: Utilizing the GPT-5.2 Chat model via the Chat Completions API to ingest architectural site images and textual zoning requirements, performing cross-referenced compliance checks.
steps: Convert architectural site plans into image formats compatible with the model's input modalities.
Structure municipal zoning regulations into a text-based knowledge base for context injection.
Invoke the v1/chat/completions endpoint using the gpt-5.2-chat-latest model ID.
Enable structured_outputs to ensure the model returns compliance findings in a machine-readable format.
Implement streaming to provide immediate feedback to architects as the model analyzes specific building sections.
outcome: Architects receive rapid, preliminary compliance assessments, allowing for iterative design adjustments before formal submission.
limitation: The model may experience hallucinations regarding specific numerical setbacks; verify output by cross-referencing the model's cited zoning clauses against the source document.
